description: This PHP class, ExceptionSubscriber, listens for exception events in a Symfony-based application and modifies HTTP responses based on exception types, replacing the response with appropriate HTTP status codes and headers.

classes.name: ExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens for exception events in a Symfony framework application and sets the HTTP response accordingly, handling both HTTP exceptions and general exceptions.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this subscriber wants to listen to, specifically the Kernel exception event with a specified priority.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the exception event by modifying the response based on whether the exception is an HTTP exception or a general exception.
